in_hebrew.name: רנאוד
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name 'Renaud' in Hebrew can be translated as 'Exalted Counsel'. This name conveys the idea of wise and respected advice that comes from a position of authority and expertise.

in_greek.name: Ρεναυδ
in_greek.long_meaning: The name 'Renaud' in Greek can be translated as 'Strong Counsel'. This name reflects the idea of a powerful and wise advisor who can provide guidance and protection.
